## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (pipeline code), or screenshots in light and dark mode (dashboard)
- [ ] `uv run pytest` and `uv run ruff check .` pass
- [ ] No workflow that runs on a self-hosted runner is triggered by `pull_request`
- [ ] If this can change measured numbers: it is a new config or rules version, or logged as a machine change
